names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Ιουλίου, «Άγιος Ηλίας Αρχιεπίσκοπος Θεσσαλονίκης», with the rank word and the see left off. The page glosses the name as a Hebrew word, the one who has divine power.

floruit.note: saint.gr gives him only the one year: he co-signs the patriarch Eutychius's letter to Pope Vigilius «Στις 6 Ιανουαρίου του 553 μ.Χ.», and he is absent from the council «που συνήλθε το ίδιο έτος (5 Μαΐου - 2 Ιουνίου 553 μ.Χ.)». The page gives no year of his birth and none of his death.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Ηλίας Αρχιεπίσκοπος Θεσσαλονίκης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and credits the Holy Metropolis of Thessalonica. He is none of the corpus's other men of the name — Elias of Calabria, Elias Ardounis, the companions of Jonah and of Terentius, the one martyred with Patermuthius, Elias (Nikolayevich) — none of whom is a sixth-century archbishop of Thessalonica; and he is not `acholius-of-thessalonica` or `symeon-of-thessalonica`, who are other bishops of that see on other days. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence; the page prints no hymn, no distich, no account of his death and no relics. It is placed on this day with the hundred and sixty-five fathers of the Fifth Ecumenical Council, whom the same calendar keeps here as a company, and that company is not drafted.
